english.note: Use 炒 as the everyday all-purpose verb for firing someone from a job.
Use 炒 as the all-purpose colloquial verb for dismissing someone from a job.

examples.english: The company chose to dismiss him.
Our company decided to fire the employee who was always late.
examples.traditional: 我哋公司今日炒咗嗰個成日遲到嘅員工。
